notes.orientation: Matches user's 2026-10-22 marked drawing: middle plastic rib horizontal, controller above/right, lever block below/left of center. Photo-derived connector positions rotated 90 degrees clockwise from previous model.

notes.wiring: Lever remains horizontal, turned end-for-end to put the four-port side towards matrix and controller. Incoming supply uses opposite two-port side. Latest user: controller pigtail exactly 100 mm. Both short leads now have schematic routes below their lengths. Check actual connector circuit grouping and polarity. Routes are estimates, not a validated harness design.
